places.name: Auschwitz

desc.en: Auschwitz, also known as Oświęcim, was a complex of over 40 concentration and extermination camps operated by Nazi Germany in occupied Poland during World War II and the Holocaust.
desc.es: El complejo Auschwitz estuvo formado por diversos campos de concentración y exterminio de la Alemania nazi en los territorios polacos ocupados durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

places.admission: Timed-entry booking is usually required; book on the official site before travel.

places.name: Wieliczka Salt Mine
